translations.web: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.
translations.bsb: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show it by his good conduct, by deeds done in the humility that comes from wisdom.
translations.kjv: Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom.
translations.asv: Who is wise and understanding among you? let him show by his good life his works in meekness of wisdom.
